english.title: Leave cargo / baggage or park a vehicle / equipment other than in a place provided by Gatwick Airport Limited
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Gatwick Airport - London to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), and without lawful authority or excuse or having first obtained the permission of Gatwick Airport Limited

(A)_[left cargo, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CARGO..),]_
(B)_[left baggage, namely **(..SPECIFY THE BAGGAGE..),]_
(C)_[parked a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..),]_
(D)_[parked equipment, namely **(..SPECIFY THE EQUIPMENT..).]_

elsewhere than in a place provided by Gatwick Airport Limited for the

(E)_[accommodation of such cargo]_
(F)_[accommodation of such baggage]_
(G)_[parking of such a vehicle]_
(H)_[parking of such equipment]_
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 6(3) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
